title: Purchase Order Receive previews the tier's new price
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new purchase order for this test with two special-order parts, both category A, cost $100.00: one requested on a new work order for customer A (priced $121.50, tier A), one on a new work order for customer B (priced $135.00, Default).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open the purchase order's Receive window.
  2. Type 200.00 as the received cost of both parts.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The purchase order's Receive window opens with both parts.

Step 2:

  • The notice reads "Updating the cost also updates the sell price."
  • Customer A's part previews $243.00 from tier A's rule ($200.00 × 1.35 = $270.00 × 0.90 = $243.00).
  • Customer B's part previews $270.00, its kept margin ($200.00 ÷ (1 − 0.2593) = $270.00).
